findings.body: Raise: Gate — Both `.claude/skills/forge/SKILL.md:628` and `.codex/skills/forge/SKILL.md:628` revert unrelated dependency-refresh guidance: the selected diff removes the Yarn 1 qualifier, the Yarn 3+ recursive command and the Yarn 2 lockfile procedure. The shipped template still contains these instructions at `src/forge/templates/skill.md:632–636`, leaving the checked-in coordinator guides inconsistent with it. This breaks “Touch only what the task needs” and removes existing version-specific instructions without any connection to Claude defaults. This is new evidence distinct from the earlier ruling about inherited board/merge guidance; the latest proof's claim that Yarn drift is excluded does not match this diff. Preserve the baseline Yarn guidance in both host guides.
findings.title: Standard: Touch only what the task needs

why: When Claude implements or plan-reads, Forge's defaults use Opus, but the owner wants Claude implementation (build, fix, lite and design, frontend included) and plan reads on Sonnet at xhigh effort by default (2026-10-09)
